note: Pinned vintages for the Measuring New York series. All chapters use these unless a chapter's worklog entry explicitly justifies a different vintage. See plan §5.3.

acs.notes: CDs are not a Census geography; approximated via PUMA crosswalks for borough/CD-level summaries.

nyc_open_data_snapshot.note: All NYC Open Data (Socrata) endpoints queried with a SoQL date filter <= '2026-06-01T00:00:00.000' to lock the snapshot.

mta_gtfs.note: Save the downloaded zips under cache/mta_gtfs/<bundle>-2026-06-01.zip

osm_overpass.note: Cache raw Overpass JSON under cache/osm/<query-name>-2026-06-01.json

lehd_lodes.note: Workplace Area Characteristics (WAC) — jobs per Census block. Aggregated to tract for spatial joins. 2022 is the latest year published in LODES8 at vintage freeze. C000 column = total jobs across all NAICS.

oca_evictions.vintage_exception: Series freeze is 2026-06-01; HDC's S3 publish at time of Ch. 2 work is 2026-05-10. The OCA ETL runs ~monthly off an OCA SFTP feed, so a fresher snapshot may not exist by 2026-06-01. Re-pin the snapshot in this manifest if a 2026-06-01-or-later release is available when Ch. 2 finalizes.
oca_evictions.geography: ZIP-only (postalcode in oca_addresses.csv). No BBL/BIN. CD aggregation via zip→CD crosswalk in shared/zip_to_cd.py.
oca_evictions.note: True court filings, not marshal-executed evictions. Same source the Furman Center, Right to Counsel NYC, and the Cornell ILR dashboard use. ETL repo: https://github.com/housing-data-coalition/oca

nypd_complaints.subset: seven major felonies (ky_cd 101 murder, 104 rape, 105 robbery, 106 felony assault = VIOLENT; 107 burglary, 109 grand larceny, 110 GLA motor vehicle = PROPERTY), law_cat_cd='FELONY'
nypd_complaints.geography: State Plane x_coord_cd/y_coord_cd (EPSG:2263); CD assigned by point-in-polygon.
nypd_complaints.vintage_exception: Series freeze is 2026-06-01, but crime is an event stream — a fixed 3-year window (2022-2024) is used so per-CD rates are stable, not single-year noise. Rates annualized.
nypd_complaints.note: Chapter 6 (Safety). 375,823 complaints fetched; ~2,292 lacked a CD match and were dropped.

nypd_collisions.subset: crashes injuring or killing a pedestrian or cyclist (ped+cyclist KI). Public data lacks injury severity, so this is killed-OR-injured, not strict Vision-Zero KSI.
nypd_collisions.note: Chapter 6 (Safety). 39,550 harm-crashes fetched; 40,318 ped+cyclist casualties, 379 killed over the window.

community_districts_59.note: NYC Open Data dataset 5crt-au7u: DCP Community Districts (current version 26a, 59 CDs + 12 JIAs). BoroCD encodes borough in first digit + CD number in last two.

nta_2020.note: NYC Open Data: 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas (NTAs)

modzcta.note: NYC Open Data: Modified ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
